reasons.plausibility: This hypothesis aligns with well-established tribological principles of oxidation-based surface protection, though synergy with other alloying elements could introduce uncertainties.
reasons.testability: A direct comparison of wear performance and oxide layer integrity between compositions can be done via standard pin-on-disk tests and surface analyses, making the proposed test both clear and decisive.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a concrete route to optimize high-entropy coatings via compositional adjustments and clarifies the mechanistic role of oxide layers in wear protection.
